name: ga-tax-overview
description: Gabon tax-pack intake reference for identifying the taxpayer, period and separate income, company, turnover and payroll obligations. Use for a Gabon tax overview, first-country assessment or routing a cross-border question to the correct source-ledger Guide without treating Guide presence as complete coverage. Use this Guide to identify the facts, statutory computation and source documents needed before preparing a working paper. It separates the historical code baseline from the enacted finance-law amendments read for this draft. It does not certify the complete 2026 amendment chain or authenticated filing screens. Missing procedures and unresolved old topics are listed explicitly, and the pack remains partial until those gaps and independent review are complete.
